main_body: Four-storey office/school block: a flat roof deck with rooftop units and a skylight, above a facade of window rows and a ground-floor glass entrance
top_band: Roof deck, light lilac-grey L≈147-168 with panel seams, scan rows 7-37, closed at the front by a light edge line (rows 38-40, L 189-235) and a dark green stripe; the front facade is lighter (L≈180-230) below
evidence: Reading the column from the top: dark outline, a light parapet rim, then a large roof surface that is clearly a horizontal plane (rooftop AC units and a skylight sit on it). A bright front-edge line (rows 39-40) follows, then a darker row and a green stripe that act as an eave shadow, then the vertical facade. The step from the roof (L≈147) to the edge line and facade (L 190-235) is well over 25 L. The windows have lighter sills and darker inner edges, so they read as inset. The roof is tall relative to the facade, but it is a distinct top surface above a distinct front face, so it satisfies the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The outline is tinted (0% neutral dark edge pixels), against 7-9% for the references. The plaster is speckled, the roof has seam lines, and the windows carry glass highlights and sills. Median colours per tile is 9, close to the stone reference (11) but below the richer one (18). Flat-fill coverage is 9%, low and confined to small areas. Total colours (32) are well below the references (66 and 185), and the repeated window grid is somewhat uniform. Overall it is a little thinner than the references but not a sticker-like, flat piece.
